items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Big Cube Summer 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Burany, Florian Truckenthanner, Felix Strasser, Lucas Höglinger, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: ## Southern Ontario Summer 2023 Series We are running three competitions ([Newmarket](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSNewmarket2023), [Oshawa](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSOshawa2023), and [Waterloo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSWaterloo2023)) as part of the Southern Ontario Summer 2023 Series. All three competitions are happening on the same day with nearly identical schedules. Please register for the competition that is nearest to you. You will only be able to compete in *one* of these three competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Stockholmsligan Final 2023
items.information: Varmt välkomna till finaltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2023! Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- A warm welcome to final competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2023! More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce South Africa's 2023 National Championship. Compete against South Africa's fastest speedcubers and break some records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/216560-cubingza-national-championship-2023#/) page. # COMPETING This is an open championship - meaning anyone is free to compete. All WCA events except FMC* will be held, with winners in each event being declared the 2023 South African Champion for that event. # SPECTATORS Competitors are allowed to bring up to 2 guests as spectators. Spectators attend for free. # VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at this video. Parents and spectators are welcome to help out with volunteer tasks as well. # SPONSORS Massive thanks to the following sponsors, without whom this competition would not be happening. BMG, who are generously providing their venue at BMG World for the competition, and making Nationals in Joburg a reality. Speecubes.co.za and CubeCo, South Africa's local cube stores, who will be sponsoring prize money and store vouchers for the competition's winners. InsightEdge (Pty) Ltd. has also generously offered to sponsor further prize money towards the winners and podium finishers. *\\*A separate FMC Championship will be held at a later date. This championship will take place simultaneously in multiple locations (CPT, JHB and DBN) to minimise travel requirements.*

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 25 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 24:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 25 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 24:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. items.information: Hjertelig velkommen til vår andre hverdagskubing på LSP i Oslo. Kveldens konkurranse har et veldig spesielt opplegg, der hver deltaker har 18 minutter i total løsningstid til å gjennomføre alle sine løsninger. Det er deltageren selv som på forhånd velger hvilke grener man vil delta i og bruke sine 18 minutter på. Konkurransen foregår mandag kveld og varer i tilsammen ca 4 timer og du kan delta i maks 5 grener. Vi holder til i et lite lokale sentralt i Oslo der LSPkuberne pleier å ha kubetreff. Vi håper at både erfarne og nye speedcubere i Oslo har lyst til å prøve seg på konkurranser lokalt. Vi vil lage månedlige konkurranser framover og se hvilket format som funker. Målet er å starte Osloligaen til høsten, der vi kårer en vinner etter resultatene fra flere små konkurranser gjennom høsten og vinteren. Lokalet er har minimalt med tilskuerplass, så det er fint hvis antall gjester er så lavt som mulig. Konkurransen er sponset av NORDICUBE og SLOAP. -------------------- Welcome to the second edition of LSP Hverdagskubing in Oslo. This competitions has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves. The competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, that each competitor can choose a maximum of five (5) events to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a Monday, lasts only approx. 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Hverdagskubing") so you don't miss any important information. We are based in a small venue in the center of Oslo where the LSPcubers tend to have cube meetings. We hope that both experienced and new speedcubers in Oslo want to join these local competitions. We will create monthly competitions in the future and see which format works. The aim is to start the Oslo League in the autumn, where we will choose a winner based on the results of several small competitions throughout the autumn and winter. The venue has limited space for guests. Please bring as few guests as possible. The competition is sponsored by NORDICUBE and SLOAP.

items.information: # Please Be Quiet! Most of the events at this competition are blindfolded events, which require significant levels of concentration, focus, and practice. All attendees, including guests, are expected to remain silent during these events while in the competition room. There will be areas outside of the venue room where competitors and guests can talk at a normal volume. ### Note for new competitors: Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) and/or Clock, this might not be the best experience for new competitors and their guests. Also note that due to the venue space, this may not be the best competition for spectators. Please consider registering for another competition if this one isn't for you.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.information: Velkommen til hverdagskubing på LSP i Oslo. Dette er et nytt arrangement i Oslo der ideen er å arrangere mindre konkurranser på hverdagskvelder gjennom hele året. Vi holder til i et lite lokale sentralt i Oslo der LSPkuberne pleier å ha kubetreff. Vi håper å nå både erfarne og nye speedcubere i Oslo som har lyst til å prøve seg på konkurranser lokalt. Vi vil lage månedlige konkurranser fram til sommeren og se hvilket format som funker. Målet er å starte Osloligaen til høsten, der vi kårer en vinner etter resultatene fra flere små konkurranser gjennom høsten og vinteren. Konkurransen er sponset av Nordicube.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

venue.address: 18 Lente St, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7945, South Africa

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the second Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will take on a "Big & Weird" theme on Saturday, with bigger NxN cubes and some side events not often held in Cape Town, with a more familiar event structure on Sunday! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/208588-cubingza-cape-cubes-autumn-2023/#/) page. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 22 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 21:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 22 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 21:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.information: ## Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before April 1, 2023 at 7:00 PM EDT. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: **Deutsch** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur ersten Competition in **Leipzig** in der Geschichte der WCA. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig und ein motiviertes Orga-Team. Lasst uns gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass die Competition **Rahn Education Leipzig** ein traditionelles Event in der WCA wird. **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** We cordially invite you to the first competition in **Leipzig** in the history of the WCA. After more than 12 years, there is finally a competition in Saxony and we, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig and a motivated organizational team. items.information: [FR] **Cette compétition est en série** Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Open de Gatineau A 2023. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). En raison de la situation sanitaire, les conditions d'accès à la compétition peuvent changer au gré des annonces gouvernementales. L'équipe d'organisation vous informera des restrictions en vigueur à chaque changement. Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet [Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpendeGatineauB2023#25349-sante-securite-health-safety). Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée. **Avis de droit à l'image**: Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.information: We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Nanaimo, B.C., for the Nanaimo Swing into Spring 2023 cubing competition. Our [last competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NanaimoBacktoSchool2022) was a great success and we are looking forward to seeing you all again. Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed. We look forward to a full house of 110 competitors! Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. For example, if you're only competing in events that are on Saturday, then you don't need to come on Sunday. Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

items.name: Save Ramir Cubing Kazakhstan 2023
items.information: Соревнование проводится с благотворительной целью. Все вырученные средства пойдут в помощь сбору средств на лечение 3-летнего ребенка с инвалидностью Рамира Ковалевского, с диагнозом «Спинальная мышечная атрофия 2 типа», который нуждается в самом дорогостоящем лекарственном препарате в мире, ZOLGENSMA. Главный спонсор соревнования – компания «Леовит». Соревнование проводится при поддержке школы №157 и общественного фонда «Alem Asar».. Смотрите наш аккаунт в Instagram (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers), чтобы узнавать новости и подробную информацию о соревновании! Соревнование будет проходить в спортзале школы №157. Будем рады видеть вас на соревновании! Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында өткізеді. Жарыстан бүкіл түскен қаражат спиналды бұлшық атрофия диагнозына шалдыққан мүгедекке 3 жасар бала Рамир Ковалевскийге әлемде ең бағалы дәрі «ZOLGENSMA» сатып алу үшін қаржы жинауға және көмектесуге бағыттайды Жарыстың бас демеушісі – «Леовит» компаниясы. Жарыс мектептiң №157 мен «Alem Asar» қоғамдық қорының көмегiмен өткiзіледi. Біздің Instagram аккаунтымыздың парақшасында (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) жаңалықтар және жарыс туралы ақпарат көре аласыздар! Жарыс мектептің №157 спорт залында өткізіледі. Сіздің жарысқа белсенді ат салысып қатысқаныңызға қуаныштымыз! The competition is organised for charity. All the proceeds made from the competition will be spent for fundraising for helping 3-years old kid, Ramir Kovalevsky, in his spinal muscular atrophy medical treatment to purchase him the most expensive cure in the world, ZOLGENSMA. The Leovit company is the main sponsor of the competition. The competition is organised with the help of school #157 and Alem Asar social foundation. Watch our posts in our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) to learn the news and more information about the competition! The competition will be set in the sports hall of the school #157. We will be happy to see you at the competition!

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: Wellington Summer 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2N0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83fc6c836b78e431cd8e0d013efd6be412a6e388/IMG_9500.JPG) Athens Winter Open 2023 είναι ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα , ύστερα από μία πολλά υποσχόμενη χρονιά. Στις επόμενες διοργανώσεις, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 διοργανώσεις που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστές στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 6x6 και του 7x7 πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλες οι εκδηλώσεις θα είναι οικείες στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή για το cubing γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείτε ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca και να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Athens Winter Open 2023 is the first competition this year in Greece, following a very successfull year of competitions. In the next competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 6x6 and 7x7 closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the eca site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition. **N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. Esta competição será realizada em um formato diferente do tradicional, neste campeonato, os competidores terão uma hora de limite para fazer todos os eventos que quiserem na ordem em que desejarem. Em um grupo serão juízes, no outro, competidores e em outro, embaralhadores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners This competition will happen in a format different from the traditional, at this competition, the competitors will have an hour to do all the events they want in the order they want. In a group they will be judges, on the other, competitors and in a last one, scramblers.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).** * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. * **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.** --- Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).** * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office. * **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

Torneo oficial que se realizará en el Museo Metropolitano de Monterrey, lugar emblemático de la capital regiomontana que tiene más de 100 años de existencia en los que tuvo varias funciones, como ser la sede del gobierno municipal, y siendo actualmente el hogar de resguardo de 300 piezas históricas. Ahora, pasa a ser el sitio oficial para esta competencia que es la segunda parte de la **Ruta Regia**. Te invitamos a formar parte de este torneo que se celebrará en el centro de la ciudad, que será abierto a todos los participantes que deseen competir. Esperamos que puedas asistir. > Todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) al participar en esta competencia. # ¡WELCOME TO MACRO MONTERREY 2022! Official tournament that will take place at the Museo Metropolitano de Monterrey, an emblematic place in the capital of Nuevo Leon that has existed for more than 100 years in which it had many functions, such as being the place of the municipal government, and currently has 300 historical pieces. Now, it becomes the official place for this competition, which is the second part of the **Ruta Regia**. We invite you to be part of this tournament that will be held in the center of the city, which is open to anyone. We hope you can attend. > All competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a)

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Newmarket Side Events 2022
items.information: ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. All competitors must be available to judge and scramble at this competition. Please read the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewmarketSideEvents2022#21475-competitor-responsibilities). ## Nearby Competitions Newmarket Side Events 2022 features "side events" and will not have the standard 3x3x3 Cube as an event. If you are looking to compete in 3x3x3 Cube, please consider registering for [Oakville Fall A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallA2022) *or* [Oakville Fall B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallB2022). ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

items.information: 11/3に行われるAyase Autumn A 2022(**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) と11/6に行われる[Ayase Autumn B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnB2022) (以下、B大会) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 **A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 3x3x3 目隠し / スクエア1 / スキューブ / クロック / 3x3x3複数 目隠し** B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 5x5x5 キューブ / 6x6x6 キューブ / メガミンクス (2ラウンド) 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。 競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。** また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。 ### 会場についての注意 ### 今回の会場は集会室1,2共に**靴を脱いで**利用する部屋となります。そのため、衛生上の観点から競技者及び見学者の方は**靴下の着用**をお願いします。 Ayase Autumn A 2022 (**This competition, A**) and [Ayase Autumn B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnB2022) (B) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these series competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, only the earliest one will be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. **A: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 3x3x3 blindfolded / Square-1 / Skewb / Clock / 3x3x3 Multi-Blind** B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 5x5x5 Cube / 6x6x6 Cube / Megaminx (2 round) The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. **Only the companions of competitors are allowed to enter the venue as spectators.** Being mindful of space, we can only accept requests of **1 companion at MAX per competitor.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors) ### Attention ### In room 1 and 2, you have to take off your shoes. So, you must wear socks due to hygienic reasons.

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022! ### This year's UK National Championship ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. *Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!* ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion. *Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.information: This is a series competition with [Pittsburgh Summer A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PittsburghSummerA2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Pittsburgh Summer A 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected. # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, July 31st is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, August 10th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

items.name: Abierto del Mirador 2022
items.information: Bienvenidos al Abierto del Mirador 2022, nos complace traerles nuevamente un torneo a la Provincia de Buenos Aires. Nuestro evento contará con 10 categorías oficiales de la WCA distribuidas en 17 rondas. Solo se harán devoluciones del total del pago ($1000) a quienes estén en lista de espera una vez lleno el cupo de 60 competidores siempre y cuando se confirme que no asistirán al torneo antes del mismo, no se harán devoluciones luego del evento. Se aceptarán los registros por orden de llegada del e-mail correspondiente con comprobante a la casilla de correo del organizador. Pedimos que dentro de las posibilidades se atienda al torneo con un (1) acompañante por cuestiones de espacio físico en el lugar del torneo. Pedimos puntualidad a todos y recomendamos llegar al menos 15 minutos antes de cualquier categoría en la que el competidor vaya a participar. Welcome to Abierto del Mirador 2022, we are pleased to bring you again a tournament to the Province of Buenos Aires. Our competition will feature 10 official WCA events distributed in 17 rounds. Refunds of the total payment ($1000) will only be made to those who are on the waiting list once the quota of 60 competitors is filled as long as it is confirmed that they will not attend the tournament beforehand, no refunds will be made after the event. Registrations will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis with proof of receipt to the organizer's e-mail address. We ask to attend, within the possibilities, with a maximum of one (1) companion for reasons of physical space at the tournament site. We ask for punctuality to all and recommend to arrive at least 15 minutes before any category in which the competitor will participate.

En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. ¡Os estaremos esperando! 8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach World Cube Association. Since 2005 it continues to attract best competitors who compete for national titles in all events sanctioned by World Cube Association. After successful 2021 edition this year's championship will be held in a special place - Olivia Star! Once again competing at the highest level will be accompanied by amazing views from 34th floor of Olivia Star building - highest scyscraper in northern Poland!

items.name: Blind Is Back LA 2022
items.information: Don your blindfolds and put on a harmonica holder, because **blind is back** in Southern California! Get ready for SoCal's first blindfolded cubing competition since 2018. Blindsolvers of all experience levels are welcome! Competitors should read the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindIsBackLA2022#19453-competitor-information) tab. Spectators may attend for free, but due to room capacity limitations, guests should be kept to a minimum. Since blindsolving requires a high level of concentration, all attendees are required to be silent during blindfolded events. Guests and competitors may socialize freely in Haines Hall Room A28, on the same floor as the competition venue. All attendees are required to read the [COVID-19 Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindIsBackLA2022#19452-covid-19-safety) tab. Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/SoCalCubing) to hear about competitions in Southern California before registration opens and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet. Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo. ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015! You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). items.information: # 🇺🇾 NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. items.name: Hive Blind 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Hive Blind 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är en sista chans att kvalificera sig inför [Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2022) i juli. Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men kom ihåg att denna tävling endast håller utvalda sido- och blindgrenar. Vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **Vi förväntar oss en mycket hög efterfrågan jämfört med antalet tillgängliga deltagarplatser för den här tävlingen, så om du vill ha en plats måste du antagligen anmäla dig direkt när registreringen öppnar.** Anmälan öppnar tisdagen den 26:e april, klockan 20:00 svensk tid. * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 20 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i matsalen på en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. --- Welcome to Hive Blind 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is a last-chance-to qualify competition before the [Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2022) in July. Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but remember that this competition only holds selected side and blind events. Please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **We expect very high demand compared to available spots for this competition, so if you want a spot, you will likely need to register the very second when registration opens.** Registration opens on Tuesday 26th April, at 20:00 Swedish time. * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 20 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is located in the canteen of an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.

For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. items.information: Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab. **Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves **Day 2:** 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks **Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis. Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. items.information: Popping Off Pukekohe B 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please note this is a **twin competition**. items.name: Güemes Open 2022
items.information: Güemes Open 2022 es la primera competencia que se va a realizar en la provincia de Salta, Argentina, y a su vez, la primera competencia del 2022 del país! El objetivo de esta competencia es reactivar la comunidad norteña del país. Nos esforzaremos en hacer cumplir todos los protocolos pertinentes a la pandemia. Competidores, recuerden ser puntuales, siguiendo los horarios del cronograma. Recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes para evitar inconvenientes, en especial a los nuevos competidores. Este torneo contará con 11 categorias oficiales y tendrá una duración de 2 días. *LEER LOS SIGUIENTES APARTADOS* https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta A pesar de no tener restricciones estrictas con la cantidad de personas que puede asistir y que el lugar es abierto y ventilado, recomendamos no llevar mas de 2 acompañantes para reducir al máximo los riesgos Güemes Open 2022 is the first competition to be held in the province of Salta, Argentina, and also, the first competition of 2022 in the country! The objective of this competition is to reactivate the northern community of the country. We will endeavor to enforce all protocols relevant to the pandemic. Competitors, remember to be punctual, following schedule. We recommend arriving 20 minutes before to avoid inconvenience, especially to new competitors. This tournament will have 11 official categories and will last 2 days. *READ THE FOLLOWING TABS* https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta Despite not having strict restrictions with the number of people who can attend and that the place is open and ventilated, we recommend not to bring more than 2 companions to minimize the risks

items.information: **[FR]** **Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.** Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**. Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA. Note : **un (1) accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir. Note : Dans le cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA annule la compétition. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new conditions** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing). Note: **Only one (1) spectator per competitor** can attend. **If you're not a competitor or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in and cancel the competition. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

items.information: Lyttelton Spring 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. items.information: This is the 2021 edition of Norrkubing. A competition which history started in 2015, and this is the 6th time a competition has been organized in this municipality. The competition is open to everyone but limited to 25 competitors due to regulations regarding covid-19. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the COVID-19 tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub website. Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses. ----- Detta är 2021 års upplaga av Norrkubing. Tävlingen arrangerades för första gången år 2015, och detta är den sjätte gången en tävling arrangeras i denna kommun. Tävlingen är öppen för alla men begränsad till maximalt 25 deltagare på grund av restriktioner kring covid-19. Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken COVID-19, med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs hemsida. Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter.

This competition is twinned with [Flen - Lilla Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021), and competitors may only register for and compete in one out of these two competitions. More on this can be found under the [Twin competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16201-tvillingtavling-twin-competition) tab. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16170-covid-19) tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2021 is the second regional championship held in New Zealand in the lead up to Nationals later in 2021.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few. Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: Tirol Open 2019
items.information: 2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol! Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte. Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab! ______ 2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol! Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well. The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2019 will crown the National Champions in all 18 official events, over the course of 3 days.
